problem_parameters.num_periods: <int> Total number of periods in the construction project planning horizon.
problem_parameters.num_containers: <int> Total number of containers in the container unit on the construction site.
problem_parameters.num_trades: <int> Total number of trades requiring container accommodation during the project.
problem_parameters.cu_width: <int> Width of the container unit in number of containers per layer.
problem_parameters.cu_depth: <int> Depth of the container unit in number of containers per layer.
problem_parameters.cu_height: <int> Number of stacked layers in the container unit.
problem_parameters.d_max: <int> Maximum number of separate container clusters any trade will tolerate.

position.x: <int> Position of this container along the width axis of the container unit.
position.y: <int> Position of this container along the depth axis of the container unit.
position.z: <int> Layer index of this container in the container unit.

containers.availability_start: <int> First period in which this container is available on-site for assignment.
containers.availability_end: <int> Last period in which this container is available on-site for assignment.
containers.adjacent_containers: <list[int]> Identifiers of all containers physically adjacent to this one within the container unit.

trades.start_period: <int> First period in which this trade is active and requires containers.
trades.end_period: <int> Last period in which this trade is active and requires containers.
trades.container_demand: <int> Number of containers this trade needs in each period it is active.
trades.max_dispersion: <int> Maximum number of separate container clusters allowed for this trade in any period.
